step0_classification.evidence: modal-runtime is the core of a 3-branch RPC fan (worker e1/e2, task engine e3, modal-daemon e8) and the source states an explicit anti-parallel pair between the same two boxes: worker -> runtime "task input + control RPCs" and runtime -> worker "events + management RPCs".

tie_breakers_considered: Density (E = N) points at flow-chains, but rule 1 makes density a separator only when a fan is absent: runtime carries three branches plus the return edge, so the fan outranks the count.
Not redundant-fabrics: only one lane per hop, no double-arrowhead target, and the source never forbids dots or claims redundancy.
Not lifecycle-machines: no phase order and no live transitions; the source's historical attempt is static, so this case is static (no dots anywhere).
Not placement-planes: one connected world, and the source names no bus between worlds (e8 is a protocol seam, not a transport bus).
Not identity-probe-maps: the only identifiers are component names; the qualifier burden is protocol names (gRPC vs HTTP over UDS), not addresses.
step0_classification.secondary_recipe: flow-chains, applied to the compute/storage tail (engine -> container backend -> task container, engine -> filesystem/volumes -> blobnet) drawn in v3: short single-stage ranks, one node per hop, corridor space per hop, no invented side branches.

blockers.blocker: pane-shell startup race in the capture harness
blockers.detail: The harness splits a pane and immediately types the launch command; the pane's shell in this tab needs 4-6 s to print its prompt (measured: 3.5 s and 5.7 s on two probes), while viz-evidence.sh's wait matches the echoed command line and then sleeps 1 s, so the first launch and its read are intermittently lost. Retried per the skill's own advice ('close it, re-split, retry') until every bundle held a real text frame and 5 timestamped frames. Harness runs: v1 1, v2 8, v3 5. No harness, validator or renderer file was modified.
